full.description: This is a low-power photomicrograph of a tissue section stained with hematoxylin and eosin. It shows a dense, sheet-like cellular infiltrate located beneath the mucosal layer of the stomach. The high cellularity is characteristic of a malignant neoplasm, with morphological features consistent with a metastatic carcinoma from a gastric primary involving a regional lymph node.

random.description: This is a low-power photomicrograph of gastric tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin. The section displays mucosal glands in the upper portion and a dense, well-circumscribed submucosal infiltrate of neoplastic round cells. The tumor mass expands the submucosa and demonstrates sheets of atypical lymphocytes. These histopathological findings are characteristic of a primary gastric lymphoma, such as MALT lymphoma.
